newsitem.title: USA: Bradlees granted amendment to $200 mln pact.
newsitem.headline: Bradlees granted amendment to $200 mln pact.

text.p: Bradlees Inc on Tuesday said it was granted an amendment to its $200 million debtor-in-possession financing agreement, providing the retailer with new minimal earnings covenants for the end of fiscal 1996 and the first quarter of fiscal 1997.

The amendment, which is subject to approval of the U.S. Bankruptcy Court, was necessitated by the company's disappointing operating results in 1996, Peter Thorner, Bradlees' new chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
